The reference image for Septoria brown spot is a strong match. Both show:
- Small, dark reddish-brown spots scattered across the leaf surface
- Yellow/chlorotic halos surrounding the spots
- Overall leaf yellowing with the spots progressing
- The bottom-right panel shows early-stage spots on green leaves very similar to the test image

The test image shows the characteristic Septoria brown spot pattern: small dark spots with yellow halos scattered across the leaf, with fallen yellowed leaves in the background (indicating bottom-up defoliation).

The background shows yellowed/fallen leaves consistent with bottom-up defoliation. This matches Septoria brown spot's signature pattern of angular dark spots with chlorotic halos, distinguishable from Bacterial Blight (which shows more water-soaked angular lesions along veins) and Frogeye (which shows spots with distinct reddish-brown ring borders)."}
